description: Housing, Northern Territory Economy is an interactive resource (dashboard, viewer or map) listed in the DITRDCSA Data Catalogue under the Regional Data Hub group, published by NT Department of Treasury and Finance. An interactive resource providing data on the Northern Territory residential housing market, produced by the NT Government. It includes property prices and rents by region, housing affordability and finance commitments, building activity and approvals. Regions are NT specific. Key facts can be downloaded via the website. Coverage is the states and territories, 2012 onward; spatial detail follows the source and is not stated in the entry. The catalogue lists the update frequency as quarterly, the status as current, and the entry was last changed on 2023-10-27. Files and pages listed: HTML (1 resources), reached from the source page and the catalogue entry, with the CKAN API giving the metadata. Access is free of charge and open; the licence is CC-BY (version not stated). Caveats: the record was written from the catalogue metadata only, so the source page was not opened, the file contents were not checked, and many entries are HTML landing pages or PDF reports, not data files. It can support capacity and investment planning studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ditrdcsa-data-catalogue-australia.
